title: metadata-protocol: a shipped base holding only another bundle member answers the canonical member differently before and after a restart
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5obaLbqgzRUR9xXfft

Filing gate: ① a reproducible defect, measured on a booted kernel. Carrier card that contract review record 6922561329 ③ on PR #34355 asks for: the reboot-dependent answer of the shipped shape is `main`'s behaviour and the same class as #33210 (one operation, one answer). PR #34355 does not move it, by scope (its row-held arm runs only for a name no package ships).

## Symptom

Base package A ships `email_template` `N` with only the `fr-FR` bundle member. Dependent package D stores the canonical member `en-US` of `N` as a row. Measured by the dev on PR #34355 (report 6924709062 on #33210, out-of-scope finding 2), on a booted kernel:

| Door (no package named) | Before restart | After restart |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `GET /api/v1/meta/email_template/N/published` | 200, D's row | 404 |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/email_template/N/layers` | 200, A's `fr-FR` | 404 |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/email_template/N` (no member) | A's `fr-FR` | |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/email_template/N?member=en-US` | 404 | |

The same request answers differently depending on whether the process has restarted, and the read naming no member serves A's `fr-FR` while the canonical member is refused.

## Location

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts` and `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`: the canonical-member mirror for a name a package ships, read before boot hydration versus after it. PR #34355 keeps this cell as it is on `main` (S1 guard, pinned without a shipped CONTROL because the shipped answer moves across a restart).

## Acceptance

1. In the shape above, `/published`, `/layers` and the plain read naming no member give one answer before and after a restart, and agree with each other.
2. The chosen answer is stated against ADR-0146 (a dependent's addition under a base's name) and ADR-0150 red line 2; if it needs a ruling, the card goes to the maintainer as a decision first.
3. Pins in `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts` for both sides of a restart, and a CONTROL with the base shipping `en-US`.

## Related

- #33210 / PR #34355: the row-held base version of this shape (moved to 404 there).
- Record 6922561329 ③ (review#2 on PR #34355).

Dedupe: the dev searched with "canonical member", "shipped base", "published", "reboot" on 2026-11-16 and found no card for this shape.
